summary: Joseph Mosseri discusses the custom of blowing a shofar at a funeral in the Halabi community and compares it with other communities. He reviews sources explaining who the shofar is blown for, why it is blown, and how many sounds are made.
questions: Is blowing a shofar at a funeral an authentic Halabi custom?
Who is the shofar blown for according to the sources?
Why is the shofar blown at a funeral?
How many sounds of the shofar are blown according to the Halabi Minhag?
